title: Add RAG instrumentation playbook and headless walkthrough
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a focused RAG instrumentation playbook and a headless walkthrough runner designed for CI-driven authoring and smoke-testing. Motivation: teams building RAG integrations need a lightweight, repeatable way to validate retrieval latency, prompt regressions, and tool-calling behavior without spinning up the full browser-based authoring studio. This PR includes: a compact playbook (README + walkthrough checklist), a Node.js headless runner (CLI) that executes authored scenarios against local or remote endpoints, telemetry probe presets (latency buckets, token breakdowns, tool-call traces), example probes and mock indexer fixtures, and basic e2e smoke tests wired into GitHub Actions. Checklist: [x] playbook content; [x] headless CLI + runner tests; [x] telemetry presets + example probes; [x] CI workflow and artifact publishing for logs; [x] docs links and usage examples. How to use: follow playbooks/rag-instrumentation/README.md for authoring scenarios, then run `yarn rag-walk --scenario ./scenarios/quick-latency.yml --target http://localhost:8080` to execute headless runs and collect JSON artifacts. This PR is intended as a low-friction developer tool for teams iterating on retrieval configs and tool-calling flows; it deliberately avoids heavyweight orchestration and focuses on reproducible assertions and telemetry output consumable by Redwood Console or local scripts. Related Linear: ENG-1145, DOC-42.
